 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dhaneshwar Prasad Gupta, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Sucheta Yadav, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
2 14-06-2023 Heard Mr. Dhaneshwar Prasad Gupta, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

The petitioner, who happens to be husband of the opposite party no. 2, apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 11 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is alleged that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with opposite party no.2 on 20.05.2021.

However, soon after the marriage she was subjected to torture on account of non-fulfillment of demand of dowry, which resulted into Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19622 of 2023(2) dt.14-06-2023 lodging of the present complaint case.
Submission has been made on behalf of the petitioner that opposite party no. 2 voluntarily deserted the petitioner, though he is ready to keep her with full dignity and honour.

sentences.text: In view of the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2, both under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, the requisites of which must be filed within a period of two weeks from today.
List this case after service of notice on opposite party no.2 or on 27.07.2023, whichever is earlier.
There shall be no coercive action against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 11 of 2022, pending before the court of learned A.C.J.M.-II, Bikramganj, Rohtas, till further orders.

(Harish Kumar, J) uday/-
